defective_pattern: Replacing the exhaustive 4-stage empirical methodological roadmap and canonical Chapter 4 Level-1 heading with a minimal stub, AND naively using regex without lookbehind to inject Persian leading zeros into decimals.
why_defective: Violates the Anti-Shortcut Invariant (Directive 25) by destroying established methodological narrative context. Furthermore, naive decimal regex substitution corrupts valid numbers (e.g., converting 71.6 to ۷۱۰.۶).
observed_symptoms: Canonical Level-1 heading '# فصل چهارم: تجزیه و تحلیل داده‌ها و یافته‌های پژوهش' goes missing.
The 4-stage methodological roadmap is replaced by a brief 3-sentence stub.
Decimals with existing integer components have a spurious '۰' injected before the decimal point.
corrective_remedy: Strictly preserve the full 4-stage methodological preamble and canonical heading. Use a negative lookbehind assertion for leading zero normalization, e.g., `(?<![0-9\u06F0-\u06F9])\.(\d+)`.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detects naive regex substitution patterns for Persian decimals without negative lookbehind
